## Summary

Hitron Technologies registers 31 MA-L blocks as "Hitron Technologies. Inc" at Hsinchu Science Park, Taiwan (one with a Seoul address), plus one as "Hitron Technology, Inc." at a Hsinchu address, which this entry treats as the same company by its address [1]. Its site lists DOCSIS cable modems and gateways, Wi-Fi products, 5G, fibre ONT/ONUs, coax test tools and home-network management, and shows the logos of Comcast, Charter, Cable One, Mediacom, Rogers and Shaw [2]. A MAC in a Hitron block is therefore most likely a cable modem or gateway rented from a North American cable operator.

DeviWiki documents the silicon: Intel Puma cable SoCs (DHCE2652, DNCE2500GU, FHCE2712M, Puma 7) paired with Qualcomm Atheros QCA9880 or QCA9984, Ralink or MediaTek Wi-Fi, and lists FCC IDs under the U4P and 2AHKM prefixes, for example U4P-CGNM and 2AHKM-CODA4589 [3]. Founding year, parent company, address randomization and security advisories are not documented by the sources consulted: Hitron's about page, a Wikipedia article and the FCC grantee search were not reachable from this session, and nothing is filled in from memory.
